title: Enterprise access-mode rollout: RBAC, audit logs, and KMS - coordination & comms
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Plan and coordinate the go-to-market and internal enablement for the new Enterprise access mode (RBAC + audit logs + customer KMS key support) targeted at VPC/Private deployments. This ticket centralizes cross-team tasks: release notes editing and localization, console and API comms, SRE rollout checks, sales/CS enablement artifacts, onboarding templates for early customers, and post-launch monitoring dashboards. Goal is a low-friction enablement for pilot customers and clear public release messaging for self-serve Private customers.
goals: Publish clear, actionable release notes and migration guidance for RBAC, audit logs, and KMS
Coordinate cross-functional dry-run with SRE, Security, Console, and Docs teams before customer enablement
Enable Sales and CS with customer-specific onboarding checklists and demo scripts
Ship console UX labels and API flags with matching documentation and telemetry hooks
acceptance_criteria: Release notes live on docs site and LinkedIn-style changelog by release cut-off (2026-03-22)
Customer onboarding checklist and sample terraform snippet available in drive
Console shows 'Enterprise access mode' toggle in private deployments (QA verified)
SRE runbook validated in a staging dry-run and post-launch alert thresholds defined
Security sign-off for KMS integration and audit log retention is recorded
rollout_plan: Week -2: Finalize release notes, create customer-specific enablement bundles, and record demo video
Week -1: Execute cross-team dry-run (SRE, Security, Console, Docs, SDKs); address issues
Day 0: Feature flagged release to private environments; notify pilot customers in advance
Day 1-7: Monitor telemetry (errors, RBAC denial rates, KMS failures), run daily incident reviews
Week +2: Collect feedback from first 3 pilot customers, iterate on docs and console copy
communication_plan: Internal: Slack #product-announce and #sre-alerts posting at Day -1 and Day 0; attach runbook and links
Customers (pilot): Email to pilot cohort 72h prior, dedicated onboarding call and migration window suggestions
Public: Release notes + changelog entry + short blog post highlighting enterprise controls and migration paths
Sales/CS: Enablement packet in Drive with demo scripts, objection-handling FAQ, and estimated migration effort
release_notes_draft: Enterprise access mode: GA for Private/VPC deployments. Key features: role-based access control for team-level permissions; streaming audit logs configurable retention and export; customer-managed keys (KMS) support for encryption at rest. Migration notes: existing private tenants will keep current access until they opt into Enterprise access mode; enabling KMS requires a brief maintenance window and validation of key policies. See 'Migration & Testing' section for Terraform examples and a checklist for rollouts.
enablement_materials: Ops runbook (Confluence) - step-by-step enablement and rollback
Customer onboarding checklist (Drive) - preflight, enable, verify
Terraform snippets and API examples (Drive) - enablement and sample policies
Sales/CS cheat sheet (Drive) - talking points and migration timelines
Recorded demo video (internal) - 12 min walkthrough of console and API flows
launch_risks: KMS key misconfiguration causing customer key rejects
RBAC rule gaps that accidentally over-restrict or over-permit resources
Audit log ingestion spikes leading to storage or pipeline throttling
Docs mismatches between console copy and API behavior causing support tickets
Insufficient CS bandwidth for larger-than-expected pilot migrations
mitigation_actions: Preflight validator for KMS keys included in onboarding checklist
Conservative default RBAC templates and safety bypass for emergency access
Rate-limiting and backpressure for audit log exporters added to pipeline (ENG-8201)
Docs freeze and doc/engineering pairing to ensure parity; update window protected
Dedicated CS migration slots reserved for first 6 pilot customers
